items.evidence: Reservoir slot 1 and plate slot 2 loaded with the correct load names and labels; p20 left with 20ul rack slot 10, p300 right with 300ul rack slot 11.
Log shows 12 aspirates of 100 uL from reservoir A1 and dispenses into plate A1 through A12 with p300; no other wells touched.
Log line 1 picks up a tip before any aspiration and line 26 drops the tip at the end.
apiLevel 2.15 is within the allowed range, 100 uL is within p300 limits, and the simulation passed.
The protocol does exactly the single transfer requested, with no extra steps and no misleading comments or metadata.

judge.summary: The protocol loads the specified labware and pipettes correctly and transfers 100 uL from reservoir A1 to plate wells A1-A12 with the p300. It uses a single tip and drops it at the end, and the simulator run matches the task.
